CustomField.description: Which section of the Intelligence panel a neighbour of this node type belongs under: Structure, Automation, Code, Security, or Data. Registry-driven rather than hardcoded in Apex or LWC, so introducing a new metadata type places it in the right section with no code change (ADR-0011). Left blank means the type is only summarised generically and never gets its own section.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Structure, Automation, Code, Security, or Data. Controls which Intelligence panel section this node type appears under.
CustomField.label: Intelligence Category
